name: Headword
description: Written representation of the canonical form

name: Gender
description: Grammatical gender of the lexeme (inherent LexicalEntry property; lexinfo:gender)

name: Dialect
description: Rollup of per-tile dialects (pipe-separated); authoritative dialect is on the sense/form/pronunciation tiles

name: Source Label
description: Layer source code (which layer supplied this form: attested vs computed)

name: Grammatical Class Value
description: Noun declension 1-5/irr; verb conjugation 1/2/irr; adjective declension 1-3

name: Confidence
description: Confidence in the grammatical class assignment (attested from a paradigm/code vs inferred by the guesser)
